LongTermDebtNoncurrent.description: Amount after unamortized (discount) premium and debt issuance costs of long-term debt classified as noncurrent and excluding amounts to be repaid within one year or the normal operating cycle, if longer. Includes, but not limited to, notes payable, bonds payable, debentures, mortgage loans and commercial paper. Excludes capital lease obligations.
LongTermDebtNoncurrent.label: Long-term Debt, Excluding Current Maturities

LossContingencyAccrualCarryingValuePayme.description: Amount of payments made reducing loss contingency liability.
LossContingencyAccrualCarryingValuePayme.label: Loss Contingency Accrual, Payments (Deprecated 2016-01-31)

LossOnCashFlowHedgeIneffectiveness.description: The loss recognized in earnings during the reporting period representing the amount of the cash flow hedges' ineffectiveness.
LossOnCashFlowHedgeIneffectiveness.label: Loss on Cash Flow Hedge Ineffectiveness

LossOnDerivativeInstrumentsPretax.description: Aggregate loss on all derivative instruments charged against earnings during the period, before tax effects.
LossOnDerivativeInstrumentsPretax.label: Loss on Derivative Instruments, Pretax

LossOnFairValueHedgeIneffectiveness.description: Amount of recognized loss from the hedging ineffectiveness of a fair value hedge.
LossOnFairValueHedgeIneffectiveness.label: Loss on Fair Value Hedge Ineffectiveness

MachineryAndEquipmentGross.description: Amount before accumulated depreciation of tangible personal property used to produce goods and services, including, but is not limited to, tools, dies and molds, computer and office equipment.
MachineryAndEquipmentGross.label: Machinery and Equipment, Gross

MarketableSecuritiesNoncurrent.description: Amount of investment in marketable security, classified as noncurrent.
MarketableSecuritiesNoncurrent.label: Marketable Securities, Noncurrent

MarketableSecuritiesRealizedGainLoss.description: Amount of realized gain (loss) on investment in marketable security, including other-than-temporary impairment (OTTI).
MarketableSecuritiesRealizedGainLoss.label: Marketable Securities, Realized Gain (Loss)

MarketingAndAdvertisingExpense.description: The total expense recognized in the period for promotion, public relations, and brand or product advertising.
MarketingAndAdvertisingExpense.label: Marketing and Advertising Expense

MinorityInterest.description: Total of all stockholders' equity (deficit) items, net of receivables from officers, directors, owners, and affiliates of the entity which is directly or indirectly attributable to that ownership interest in subsidiary equity which is not attributable to the parent (that is, noncontrolling interest, previously referred to as minority interest).
MinorityInterest.label: Stockholders' Equity Attributable to Noncontrolling Interest

MinorityInterestDecreaseFromRedemptions.description: Decrease in noncontrolling interest (for example, but not limited to, redeeming or purchasing the interests of noncontrolling shareholders, issuance of shares (interests) by the non-wholly owned subsidiary to the parent entity for other than cash, and a buyback of shares (interest) by the non-wholly owned subsidiary from the noncontrolling interests).
MinorityInterestDecreaseFromRedemptions.label: Noncontrolling Interest, Decrease from Redemptions or Purchase of Interests

MinorityInterestOwnershipPercentageByNon.description: The equity interest of noncontrolling shareholders, partners or other equity holders in consolidated entity.
MinorityInterestOwnershipPercentageByNon.label: Noncontrolling Interest, Ownership Percentage by Noncontrolling Owners

MultiemployerPlanContributionsByEmployer.description: Amount of contributions made to multiemployer plan by employer.
MultiemployerPlanContributionsByEmployer.label: Multiemployer Plan, Contributions by Employer (Deprecated 2020-01-31)

MultiemployerPlanEmployerContributionCos.description: Amount of cost for employer contribution to multiemployer plan. Multiemployer plan includes, but is not limited to, pension plan determined to be individually significant and insignificant and other postretirement benefit plan.
MultiemployerPlanEmployerContributionCos.label: Multiemployer Plan, Employer Contribution, Cost

MultiemployerPlanPeriodContributions.description: Amount of contributions made to multiemployer plans by the employer. A multiemployer plan is a pension or postretirement benefit plan to which two or more unrelated employers contribute where assets contributed by one participating employer may be used to provide benefits to employees of other participating employers.
MultiemployerPlanPeriodContributions.label: Multiemployer Plan, Period Contributions (Deprecated 2017-01-31)

MultiemployerPlanWithdrawalObligation.description: Amount of a recognized obligation to a multiemployer plan in the event that the employer withdraws from the plan. In some situations, withdrawal from a multiemployer plan may result in an employer having an obligation to the plan for a portion of the unfunded benefit obligation of the pension plans and other postretirement benefit plans.
MultiemployerPlanWithdrawalObligation.label: Multiemployer Plan, Withdrawal Obligation (Deprecated 2012-01-31)

MultiemployerPlansCollectiveBargainingAr.description: Percentage of employee participants subject to a collective bargaining arrangement to all participants in a pension or postretirement benefit plan to which two or more unrelated employers contribute where assets contributed by one participating employer may be used to provide benefits to employees of other participating employers.
MultiemployerPlansCollectiveBargainingAr.label: Multiemployer Plans, Collective-Bargaining Arrangement, Percentage of Participants (Deprecated 2020-01-31)

MultiemployerPlansWithdrawalObligation.description: Amount of the obligation recognized by withdrawing from a pension or postretirement benefit plan to which two or more unrelated employers contribute where assets contributed by one participating employer may be used to provide benefits to employees of other participating employers.
MultiemployerPlansWithdrawalObligation.label: Multiemployer Plans, Withdrawal Obligation

NetCashProvidedByUsedInFinancingActiviti.description: Amount of cash inflow (outflow) from financing activities, including discontinued operations. Financing activity cash flows include obtaining resources from owners and providing them with a return on, and a return of, their investment; borrowing money and repaying amounts borrowed, or settling the obligation; and obtaining and paying for other resources obtained from creditors on long-term credit.
NetCashProvidedByUsedInFinancingActiviti.label: Net Cash Provided by (Used in) Financing Activities

NetCashProvidedByUsedInInvestingActiviti.description: Amount of cash inflow (outflow) from investing activities, including discontinued operations. Investing activity cash flows include making and collecting loans and acquiring and disposing of debt or equity instruments and property, plant, and equipment and other productive assets.
NetCashProvidedByUsedInInvestingActiviti.label: Net Cash Provided by (Used in) Investing Activities

NetCashProvidedByUsedInOperatingActiviti.description: Amount of cash inflow (outflow) from operating activities, including discontinued operations. Operating activity cash flows include transactions, adjustments, and changes in value not defined as investing or financing activities.
NetCashProvidedByUsedInOperatingActiviti.label: Net Cash Provided by (Used in) Operating Activities

NetIncomeLoss.description: The portion of profit or loss for the period, net of income taxes, which is attributable to the parent.
NetIncomeLoss.label: Net Income (Loss) Attributable to Parent

NetIncomeLossAttributableToNoncontrollin.description: Amount of Net Income (Loss) attributable to noncontrolling interest.
NetIncomeLossAttributableToNoncontrollin.label: Net Income (Loss) Attributable to Noncontrolling Interest

NetIncomeLossAvailableToCommonStockholde.description: Amount, after deduction of tax, noncontrolling interests, dividends on preferred stock and participating securities, and addition from assumption of issuance of common shares for dilutive potential common shares; of income (loss) available to common shareholders.
NetIncomeLossAvailableToCommonStockholde.label: Net Income (Loss) Available to Common Stockholders, Diluted

NewAccountingPronouncementOrChangeInAcco.description: Amount of cumulative effect of the change in accounting principle or new accounting pronouncement on retained earnings or other components of equity or net assets in the statement of financial position as of the beginning of the earliest period presented.
NewAccountingPronouncementOrChangeInAcco.label: New Accounting Pronouncement or Change in Accounting Principle, Cumulative Effect of Change on Equity or Net Assets (Deprecated 2020-01-31)

NoncashOrPartNoncashAcquisitionIntangibl.description: "The amount of intangibles that an Entity acquires in a noncash (or part noncash) acquisition. Noncash is defined as information about all investing and financing activities of an enterprise during a period that affect recognized assets or liabilities but that do not result in cash receipts or cash payments in the period. ""Part noncash"" refers to that portion of the transaction not resulting in cash receipts or cash payments in the period."
NoncashOrPartNoncashAcquisitionIntangibl.label: Noncash or Part Noncash Acquisition, Intangible Assets Acquired

NoncashOrPartNoncashAcquisitionOtherLiab.description: Amount of liabilities, classified as other, assumed in acquiring a business or in consideration for an asset received in a noncash or part noncash acquisition.
NoncashOrPartNoncashAcquisitionOtherLiab.label: Noncash or Part Noncash Acquisition, Other Liabilities Assumed

NoncashOrPartNoncashAcquisitionValueOfAs.description: The value of an asset or business acquired in a noncash (or part noncash) acquisition. Noncash is defined as information about all investing and financing activities of an enterprise during a period that affect recognized assets or liabilities but that do not result in cash receipts or cash payments in the period. "Part noncash" refers to that portion of the transaction not resulting in cash receipts or cash payments in the period.
NoncashOrPartNoncashAcquisitionValueOfAs.label: Noncash or Part Noncash Acquisition, Value of Assets Acquired (Deprecated 2011-01-31)

NonmonetaryTransactionAmountOfBarterTran.description: The amount of revenue and expenses for the services received and provided in a nonmonetary arrangement.
NonmonetaryTransactionAmountOfBarterTran.label: Nonmonetary Transaction, Amount of Barter Transaction

NonmonetaryTransactionGainLossRecognized.description: Disclosure of the difference in values (gain (loss)) between the nonmonetary assets or liabilities exchanged with another entity inclusive of boot (small monetary consideration).
NonmonetaryTransactionGainLossRecognized.label: Nonmonetary Transaction, Gain (Loss) Recognized on Transfer

NotesPayableRelatedPartiesCurrentAndNonc.description: The amount for notes payable (written promise to pay), due to related parties.
NotesPayableRelatedPartiesCurrentAndNonc.label: Notes Payable, Related Parties

NotesReceivableRelatedPartiesNoncurrent.description: Amounts due from parties associated with the reporting entity as evidenced by a written promise to pay, due after 1 year (or 1 business cycle).
NotesReceivableRelatedPartiesNoncurrent.label: Notes Receivable, Related Parties, Noncurrent

NotionalAmountOfInterestRateDerivatives.description: Aggregate notional amount of interest rate derivatives, which relates to the currency amount specified in the interest rate derivative instruments.
NotionalAmountOfInterestRateDerivatives.label: Notional Amount of Interest Rate Derivatives (Deprecated 2013-01-31)

NotionalAmountOfInterestRateFairValueHed.description: Aggregate notional amount of all interest rate derivatives designated as hedging instruments in fair value hedges. Notional amount refers to the monetary amount specified in the interest rate derivative contract.
NotionalAmountOfInterestRateFairValueHed.label: Notional Amount of Interest Rate Fair Value Hedge Derivatives (Deprecated 2013-01-31)

NumberOfOperatingSegments.description: Number of operating segments. An operating segment is a component of an enterprise: (a) that engages in business activities from which it may earn revenues and incur expenses (including revenues and expenses relating to transactions with other components of the same enterprise), (b) whose operating results are regularly reviewed by the enterprise's chief operating decision maker to make decisions about resources to be allocated to the segment and assess its performance, and (c) for which discrete financial information is available. An operating segment may engage in business activities for which it has yet to earn revenues, for example, start-up operations may be operating segments before earning revenues.
NumberOfOperatingSegments.label: Number of Operating Segments

NumberOfReportableSegments.description: Number of segments reported by the entity. A reportable segment is a component of an entity for which there is an accounting requirement to report separate financial information on that component in the entity's financial statements.
NumberOfReportableSegments.label: Number of Reportable Segments

OperatingIncomeLoss.description: The net result for the period of deducting operating expenses from operating revenues.
OperatingIncomeLoss.label: Operating Income (Loss)

OperatingLeaseCost.description: Amount of single lease cost, calculated by allocation of remaining cost of lease over remaining lease term. Includes, but is not limited to, single lease cost, after impairment of right-of-use asset, calculated by amortization of remaining right-of-use asset and accretion of lease liability.
OperatingLeaseCost.label: Operating Lease, Cost

OperatingLeaseExpense.description: Amount of operating lease expense. Excludes sublease income.
OperatingLeaseExpense.label: Operating Lease, Expense

OperatingLeaseLiability.description: Present value of lessee's discounted obligation for lease payments from operating lease.
OperatingLeaseLiability.label: Operating Lease, Liability

OperatingLeaseLiabilityCurrent.description: Present value of lessee's discounted obligation for lease payments from operating lease, classified as current.
OperatingLeaseLiabilityCurrent.label: Operating Lease, Liability, Current

OperatingLeaseLiabilityNoncurrent.description: Present value of lessee's discounted obligation for lease payments from operating lease, classified as noncurrent.
OperatingLeaseLiabilityNoncurrent.label: Operating Lease, Liability, Noncurrent

OperatingLeasePayments.description: Amount of cash outflow from operating lease, excluding payments to bring another asset to condition and location necessary for its intended use.
OperatingLeasePayments.label: Operating Lease, Payments

OperatingLeaseRightOfUseAsset.description: Amount of lessee's right to use underlying asset under operating lease.
OperatingLeaseRightOfUseAsset.label: Operating Lease, Right-of-Use Asset

OperatingLeaseWeightedAverageDiscountRat.description: Weighted average discount rate for operating lease calculated at point in time.
OperatingLeaseWeightedAverageDiscountRat.label: Operating Lease, Weighted Average Discount Rate, Percent

OperatingLeasesFutureMinimumPaymentsDue.description: Amount of required minimum rental payments for leases having an initial or remaining non-cancelable letter-terms in excess of one year.
OperatingLeasesFutureMinimumPaymentsDue.label: Operating Leases, Future Minimum Payments Due

OperatingLeasesFutureMinimumPaymentsDueC.description: Amount of required minimum rental payments for operating leases having an initial or remaining non-cancelable lease term in excess of one year due in the next fiscal year following the latest fiscal year. Excludes interim and annual periods when interim periods are reported on a rolling approach, from latest balance sheet date.
OperatingLeasesFutureMinimumPaymentsDueC.label: Operating Leases, Future Minimum Payments Due, Next Twelve Months

OperatingLeasesFutureMinimumPaymentsDueI.description: Amount of required minimum rental payments for operating leases having an initial or remaining non-cancelable lease term in excess of one year due in the fifth fiscal year following the latest fiscal year. Excludes interim and annual periods when interim periods are reported on a rolling approach, from latest balance sheet date.
OperatingLeasesFutureMinimumPaymentsDueI.label: Operating Leases, Future Minimum Payments, Due in Five Years

OperatingLeasesFutureMinimumPaymentsDueI.description: Amount of required minimum rental payments for operating leases having an initial or remaining non-cancelable lease term in excess of one year due in the fourth fiscal year following the latest fiscal year. Excludes interim and annual periods when interim periods are reported on a rolling approach, from latest balance sheet date.
OperatingLeasesFutureMinimumPaymentsDueI.label: Operating Leases, Future Minimum Payments, Due in Four Years

OperatingLeasesFutureMinimumPaymentsDueI.description: Amount of required minimum rental payments for operating leases having an initial or remaining non-cancelable lease term in excess of one year due in the third fiscal year following the latest fiscal year. Excludes interim and annual periods when interim periods are reported on a rolling approach, from latest balance sheet date.
OperatingLeasesFutureMinimumPaymentsDueI.label: Operating Leases, Future Minimum Payments, Due in Three Years

OperatingLeasesFutureMinimumPaymentsDueI.description: Amount of required minimum rental payments for operating leases having an initial or remaining non-cancelable lease term in excess of one year due in the second fiscal year following the latest fiscal year. Excludes interim and annual periods when interim periods are reported on a rolling approach, from latest balance sheet date.
OperatingLeasesFutureMinimumPaymentsDueI.label: Operating Leases, Future Minimum Payments, Due in Two Years

OperatingLeasesFutureMinimumPaymentsDueT.description: Amount of required minimum rental payments for operating leases having an initial or remaining non-cancelable lease term in excess of one year due after the fifth fiscal year following the latest fiscal year. Excludes interim and annual periods when interim periods are reported on a rolling approach, from latest balance sheet date.
OperatingLeasesFutureMinimumPaymentsDueT.label: Operating Leases, Future Minimum Payments, Due Thereafter

OperatingLossCarryforwardsValuationAllow.description: The portion of the valuation allowance pertaining to the deferred tax asset representing potential future taxable deductions from net operating loss carryforwards for which it is more likely than not that a tax benefit will not be realized.
OperatingLossCarryforwardsValuationAllow.label: Operating Loss Carryforwards, Valuation Allowance

OriginationOfNotesReceivableFromRelatedP.description: The cash outflow for a loan, supported by a promissory note, granted to related parties where one party can exercise control or significant influence over another party; including affiliates, owners or officers and their immediate families, pension trusts, and so forth.
OriginationOfNotesReceivableFromRelatedP.label: Origination of Notes Receivable from Related Parties

OtherAccruedLiabilitiesCurrent.description: Amount of expenses incurred but not yet paid classified as other, due within one year or the normal operating cycle, if longer.
OtherAccruedLiabilitiesCurrent.label: Other Accrued Liabilities, Current

OtherAmortizationOfDeferredCharges.description: Amount of amortization of other deferred costs recognized in the income statement.
OtherAmortizationOfDeferredCharges.label: Amortization of Other Deferred Charges

OtherAssets.description: Amount of assets classified as other.
OtherAssets.label: Other Assets

OtherAssetsCurrent.description: Amount of current assets classified as other.
OtherAssetsCurrent.label: Other Assets, Current

OtherAssetsMiscellaneousCurrent.description: Amount of other miscellaneous assets expected to be realized or consumed within one year or operating cycle, if longer.
OtherAssetsMiscellaneousCurrent.label: Other Assets, Miscellaneous, Current

OtherAssetsMiscellaneousNoncurrent.description: Amount of other miscellaneous assets expected to be realized or consumed after one year or normal operating cycle, if longer.
OtherAssetsMiscellaneousNoncurrent.label: Other Assets, Miscellaneous, Noncurrent

OtherAssetsNoncurrent.description: Amount of noncurrent assets classified as other.
OtherAssetsNoncurrent.label: Other Assets, Noncurrent

OtherComprehensiveIncomeAmortizationOfDe.description: The change in other comprehensive income due to the amortization of the net prior service costs (credit) into net periodic pension costs.
OtherComprehensiveIncomeAmortizationOfDe.label: Other Comprehensive Income (Loss), Amortization, Pension and Other Postretirement Benefit Plans, Net Prior Service Cost (Credit) Recognized in Net Periodic Benefit Cost, before Tax (Deprecated 2012-01-31)

OtherComprehensiveIncomeCumulativeEffect.description: The after tax effect on other comprehensive income of a change in accounting principle recognized in the period, which occurred before retrospective adjustments were required, or is in lieu of retrospective adjustments.
OtherComprehensiveIncomeCumulativeEffect.label: Other Comprehensive Income (Loss), Effect of Change in Accounting Principle, Net of Taxes (Deprecated 2016-01-31)

OtherComprehensiveIncomeDefinedBenefitPl.description: Amount, before tax, of cost (credit) of benefit change attributable to participants' prior service from plan amendment or plan initiation of defined benefit plan, that has not been recognized in net periodic benefit cost (credit).
OtherComprehensiveIncomeDefinedBenefitPl.label: Other Comprehensive (Income) Loss, Defined Benefit Plan, Prior Service Cost (Credit), before Tax

OtherComprehensiveIncomeDefinedBenefitPl.description: Amount, before tax, after reclassification adjustment, of (increase) decrease in accumulated other comprehensive (income) loss for defined benefit plan, attributable to parent entity.
OtherComprehensiveIncomeDefinedBenefitPl.label: Other Comprehensive (Income) Loss, Defined Benefit Plan, before Tax, after Reclassification Adjustment, Attributable to Parent

OtherComprehensiveIncomeDefinedBenefitPl.description: The increase (decrease) in accumulated comprehensive income during the period related to pension and other postretirement benefit plans, after tax. While for technical reasons this element has no balance attribute, the default assumption is a credit balance consistent with its label.
OtherComprehensiveIncomeDefinedBenefitPl.label: Other Comprehensive Income (Loss), Pension and Other Postretirement Benefit Plans, Adjustment, Net of Tax (Deprecated 2012-01-31)

OtherComprehensiveIncomeDefinedBenefitPl.description: Tax effects of the increase (decrease) to accumulated comprehensive income during the period related to benefit plans. While for technical reasons this element has no balance attribute, the default assumption is a credit balance consistent with its label.
OtherComprehensiveIncomeDefinedBenefitPl.label: Other Comprehensive Income (Loss), Pension and Other Postretirement Benefit Plans, Tax (Deprecated 2012-01-31)

OtherComprehensiveIncomeDefinedBenefitPl.description: Amount, after reclassification adjustment, of tax (expense) benefit for (increase) decrease in accumulated other comprehensive income for defined benefit plan, attributable to parent.
OtherComprehensiveIncomeDefinedBenefitPl.label: Other Comprehensive (Income) Loss, Defined Benefit Plan, after Reclassification Adjustment, Tax, Attributable to Parent

OtherComprehensiveIncomeDerivativesQuali.description: Net of tax effect change in accumulated gains and losses from derivative instruments designated and qualifying as the effective portion of cash flow hedges after taxes. A cash flow hedge is a hedge of the exposure to variability in the cash flows of a recognized asset or liability or a forecasted transaction that is attributable to a particular risk. The change includes an entity's share of an equity investee's increase or decrease in deferred hedging gains or losses. While for technical reasons this element has no balance attribute, the default assumption is a credit balance consistent with its label.
OtherComprehensiveIncomeDerivativesQuali.label: Other Comprehensive Income (Loss), Derivatives Qualifying as Hedges, Net of Tax (Deprecated 2012-01-31)

OtherComprehensiveIncomeDerivativesQuali.description: Total tax effect of the change in accumulated gains and losses from derivative instruments designated and qualifying as the effective portion of cash flow hedges. The change includes an entity's share of an equity investee's increase or decrease in deferred hedging gains or losses. While for technical reasons this element has no balance attribute, the default assumption is a credit balance consistent with its label.
OtherComprehensiveIncomeDerivativesQuali.label: Other Comprehensive Income (Loss), Derivatives Qualifying as Hedges, Tax Effect (Deprecated 2012-01-31)

OtherComprehensiveIncomeDerivativesQuali.description: Amount of tax expense (benefit), after reclassification adjustments, of increase (decrease) in accumulated gain (loss) from derivative instruments designated and qualifying as the effective portion of cash flow hedges and an entity's share of an equity investee's increase (decrease) in deferred hedging gain (loss), attributable to parent entity.
OtherComprehensiveIncomeDerivativesQuali.label: Other Comprehensive Income (Loss), Derivatives Qualifying as Hedges, Tax, Portion Attributable to Parent

OtherComprehensiveIncomeForeignCurrencyT.description: Adjustment that results from the process of translating subsidiary financial statements and foreign equity investments into the reporting currency of the reporting entity, net of tax.
OtherComprehensiveIncomeForeignCurrencyT.label: Other Comprehensive Income (Loss), Foreign Currency Transaction and Translation Adjustment, Net of Tax (Deprecated 2012-01-31)

OtherComprehensiveIncomeForeignCurrencyT.description: Amount after tax and reclassification adjustments of gain (loss) on foreign currency translation adjustments, foreign currency transactions designated and effective as economic hedges of a net investment in a foreign entity and intra-entity foreign currency transactions that are of a long-term-investment nature, attributable to noncontrolling interests.
OtherComprehensiveIncomeForeignCurrencyT.label: Other Comprehensive Income (Loss), Foreign Currency Transaction and Translation Adjustment, Net of Tax, Portion Attributable to Noncontrolling Interest

OtherComprehensiveIncomeForeignCurrencyT.description: Amount after tax, before reclassification adjustments of gain (loss) on foreign currency translation adjustments, foreign currency transactions designated and effective as economic hedges of a net investment in a foreign entity and intra-entity foreign currency transactions that are of a long-term-investment nature.
OtherComprehensiveIncomeForeignCurrencyT.label: Other Comprehensive Income (Loss), Foreign Currency Transaction and Translation Gain (Loss) Arising During Period, Net of Tax

OtherComprehensiveIncomeLossAmortization.description: Before tax amount of the income statement impact of the reclassification adjustment for prior service costs recognized as a component of net period benefit cost.
OtherComprehensiveIncomeLossAmortization.label: Other Comprehensive Income (Loss), Amortization, Pension and Other Postretirement Benefit Plans, Net Prior Service Cost Recognized in Net Periodic Benefit Cost, before Tax (Deprecated 2013-01-31)

OtherComprehensiveIncomeLossBeforeReclas.description: Amount after tax, before reclassification adjustments of other comprehensive income (loss).
OtherComprehensiveIncomeLossBeforeReclas.label: Other Comprehensive Income (Loss), before Reclassifications, Net of Tax

OtherComprehensiveIncomeLossCashFlowHedg.description: Amount, after tax and reclassification, of gain (loss) from derivative instrument designated and qualifying as cash flow hedge included in assessment of hedge effectiveness.
OtherComprehensiveIncomeLossCashFlowHedg.label: Other Comprehensive Income (Loss), Cash Flow Hedge, Gain (Loss), after Reclassification and Tax

OtherComprehensiveIncomeLossCashFlowHedg.description: Amount, after reclassification, of tax expense (benefit) for gain (loss) from derivative instrument designated and qualifying as cash flow hedge included in assessment of hedge effectiveness.
OtherComprehensiveIncomeLossCashFlowHedg.label: Other Comprehensive Income (Loss), Cash Flow Hedge, Gain (Loss), after Reclassification, Tax

OtherComprehensiveIncomeLossDerivativesQ.description: Amount after tax and reclassification adjustments, of increase (decrease) in accumulated gain (loss) from derivative instruments designated and qualifying as the effective portion of cash flow hedges and an entity's share of an equity investee's increase (decrease) in deferred hedging gain (loss).
OtherComprehensiveIncomeLossDerivativesQ.label: Other Comprehensive Income (Loss), Derivatives Qualifying as Hedges, Net of Tax

OtherComprehensiveIncomeLossForeignCurre.description: Amount after tax and reclassification adjustments of gain (loss) on foreign currency translation adjustments, foreign currency transactions designated and effective as economic hedges of a net investment in a foreign entity and intra-entity foreign currency transactions that are of a long-term-investment nature.
OtherComprehensiveIncomeLossForeignCurre.label: Other Comprehensive Income (Loss), Foreign Currency Transaction and Translation Adjustment, Net of Tax

OtherComprehensiveIncomeLossNetOfTax.description: Amount after tax and reclassification adjustments of other comprehensive income (loss).
OtherComprehensiveIncomeLossNetOfTax.label: Other Comprehensive Income (Loss), Net of Tax

OtherComprehensiveIncomeLossNetOfTaxPeri.description: This element represents Other Comprehensive Income or Loss, Net of Tax, for the period. Includes deferred gains or losses on qualifying hedges, unrealized holding gains or losses on available-for-sale securities, minimum pension liability, and cumulative translation adjustment. While for technical reasons this element has no balance attribute, the default assumption is a credit balance consistent with its label.
OtherComprehensiveIncomeLossNetOfTaxPeri.label: Other Comprehensive Income (Loss), Net of Tax (Deprecated 2012-01-31)

OtherComprehensiveIncomeLossNetOfTaxPort.description: Amount after tax of other comprehensive income (loss) attributable to noncontrolling interests.
OtherComprehensiveIncomeLossNetOfTaxPort.label: Other Comprehensive Income (Loss), Net of Tax, Portion Attributable to Noncontrolling Interest

OtherComprehensiveIncomeLossNetOfTaxPort.description: Amount after tax of other comprehensive income (loss) attributable to parent entity.
OtherComprehensiveIncomeLossNetOfTaxPort.label: Other Comprehensive Income (Loss), Net of Tax, Portion Attributable to Parent

OtherComprehensiveIncomeLossPensionAndOt.description: Amount, after tax, before reclassification adjustment, of (increase) decrease in accumulated other comprehensive income of defined benefit plan, that has not been recognized in net periodic benefit cost (credit).
OtherComprehensiveIncomeLossPensionAndOt.label: Other Comprehensive (Income) Loss, Defined Benefit Plan, before Reclassification Adjustment, after Tax

OtherComprehensiveIncomeLossPensionAndOt.description: Amount, after tax and reclassification adjustment, of (increase) decrease in accumulated other comprehensive income for defined benefit plan.
OtherComprehensiveIncomeLossPensionAndOt.label: Other Comprehensive (Income) Loss, Defined Benefit Plan, after Reclassification Adjustment, after Tax

OtherComprehensiveIncomeLossPensionAndOt.description: Amount, after reclassification adjustment, of tax (expense) benefit for (increase) decrease in accumulated other comprehensive income of defined benefit plan.
OtherComprehensiveIncomeLossPensionAndOt.label: Other Comprehensive (Income) Loss, Defined Benefit Plan, after Reclassification Adjustment, Tax

OtherComprehensiveIncomeLossReclassifica.description: Amount after tax of reclassification adjustment from accumulated other comprehensive income of accumulated gain (loss) realized from derivative instruments designated and qualifying as the effective portion of cash flow hedges and an entity's share of an equity investee's deferred hedging gain (loss).
OtherComprehensiveIncomeLossReclassifica.label: Other Comprehensive Income (Loss), Reclassification Adjustment from AOCI on Derivatives, Net of Tax

OtherComprehensiveIncomeLossReclassifica.description: Amount of tax expense (benefit) of reclassification adjustment from accumulated other comprehensive income of accumulated gain (loss) realized from derivative instruments designated and qualifying as the effective portion of cash flow hedges and an entity's share of an equity investee's deferred hedging gain (loss).
OtherComprehensiveIncomeLossReclassifica.label: Other Comprehensive Income (Loss), Reclassification Adjustment from AOCI on Derivatives, Tax

OtherComprehensiveIncomeLossReclassifica.description: Amount before tax of reclassification adjustment from accumulated other comprehensive (income) loss related to net period benefit cost (credit) for pension and other postretirement defined benefit plans.
OtherComprehensiveIncomeLossReclassifica.label: Other Comprehensive (Income) Loss, Defined Benefit Plan, Reclassification Adjustment from AOCI, before Tax

OtherComprehensiveIncomeLossReclassifica.description: Amount, before tax, of reclassification adjustment from accumulated other comprehensive income (loss) for gain (loss) of defined benefit plan.
OtherComprehensiveIncomeLossReclassifica.label: Other Comprehensive Income (Loss), Defined Benefit Plan, Gain (Loss), Reclassification Adjustment from AOCI, before Tax

OtherComprehensiveIncomeLossReclassifica.description: Amount, after tax, of reclassification adjustment from accumulated other comprehensive income (loss) for gain (loss) of defined benefit plan.
OtherComprehensiveIncomeLossReclassifica.label: Other Comprehensive Income (Loss), Defined Benefit Plan, Gain (Loss), Reclassification Adjustment from AOCI, after Tax

OtherComprehensiveIncomeLossReclassifica.description: Net of tax amount of the income statement impact of the reclassification adjustment of accumulated gain (loss) from derivative instruments designated and qualifying as the effective portion of cash flow hedges realized in net income. Also includes reclassification adjustments of an entity's share of an equity investee's deferred hedging gain (loss) realized in net income.
OtherComprehensiveIncomeLossReclassifica.label: Other Comprehensive Income (Loss), Reclassification Adjustment on Derivatives Included in Net Income, Net of Tax (Deprecated 2013-01-31)

OtherComprehensiveIncomeLossReclassifica.description: Tax effect of the income statement impact of the reclassification adjustment of accumulated gain (loss) from derivative instruments designated and qualifying as the effective portion of cash flow hedges realized in net income. Also includes reclassification adjustments of an entity's share of an equity investee's deferred hedging gain (loss) realized in net income.
OtherComprehensiveIncomeLossReclassifica.label: Other Comprehensive Income (Loss), Reclassification Adjustment on Derivatives Included in Net Income, Tax (Deprecated 2013-01-31)

OtherComprehensiveIncomeReclassification.description: Before tax amount of the income statement impact of the reclassification adjustment for actuarial gain (loss) recognized as a component of net periodic benefit cost.
OtherComprehensiveIncomeReclassification.label: Other Comprehensive Income (Loss), Reclassification, Pension and Other Postretirement Benefit Plans, Net Gain (Loss) Recognized in Net Periodic Benefit Cost, before Tax (Deprecated 2013-01-31)

OtherComprehensiveIncomeUnrealizedGainLo.description: Amount after tax of increase (decrease) in accumulated gain (loss) from derivative instruments designated and qualifying as the effective portion of cash flow hedges and an entity's share of an equity investee's increase (decrease) in deferred hedging gain (loss).
OtherComprehensiveIncomeUnrealizedGainLo.label: Other Comprehensive Income (Loss), Unrealized Gain (Loss) on Derivatives Arising During Period, Net of Tax

OtherIntangibleAssetsNet.description: Amount after accumulated amortization of finite-lived and indefinite-lived intangible assets classified as other.
OtherIntangibleAssetsNet.label: Other Intangible Assets, Net

OtherInventoriesSpareParts.description: Gross amount of components of assembled products that can be sold directly or indirectly through sales of assembled products.
OtherInventoriesSpareParts.label: Other Inventories, Spare Parts, Gross

OtherLiabilitiesCurrent.description: Amount of liabilities classified as other, due within one year or the normal operating cycle, if longer.
OtherLiabilitiesCurrent.label: Other Liabilities, Current

OtherLiabilitiesNoncurrent.description: Amount of liabilities classified as other, due after one year or the normal operating cycle, if longer.
OtherLiabilitiesNoncurrent.label: Other Liabilities, Noncurrent

OtherLongTermDebt.description: Amount of long-term debt classified as other.
OtherLongTermDebt.label: Other Long-term Debt

OtherNoncashIncome.description: Amount of income or gain included in net income that result in no cash inflow (outflow), classified as other.
OtherNoncashIncome.label: Other Noncash Income

OtherNoncashIncomeExpense.description: Amount of income (expense) included in net income that results in no cash inflow (outflow), classified as other.
OtherNoncashIncomeExpense.label: Other Noncash Income (Expense)

OtherNoncurrentLiabilities.description: Obligations not otherwise itemized or previously categorized that are due beyond one year (or operating cycle, if longer) from the balance sheet date.
OtherNoncurrentLiabilities.label: Other Noncurrent Liabilities (Deprecated 2011-01-31)

OtherNonoperatingIncome.description: Amount of income related to nonoperating activities, classified as other.
OtherNonoperatingIncome.label: Other Nonoperating Income

OtherNonoperatingIncomeExpense.description: Amount of income (expense) related to nonoperating activities, classified as other.
OtherNonoperatingIncomeExpense.label: Other Nonoperating Income (Expense)

OtherOperatingIncomeExpenseNet.description: The net amount of other operating income and expenses, the components of which are not separately disclosed on the income statement, from items that are associated with the entity's normal revenue producing operations.
OtherOperatingIncomeExpenseNet.label: Other Operating Income (Expense), Net

OtherPostretirementBenefitExpense.description: Amount of cost (reversal of cost) for other postretirement benefits. Excludes pension benefits.
OtherPostretirementBenefitExpense.label: Other Postretirement Benefits Cost (Reversal of Cost)

OtherReceivables.description: Amount due from parties in nontrade transactions, classified as other.
OtherReceivables.label: Other Receivables

OtherReceivablesNetCurrent.description: Amount, after allowance, of receivables classified as other, due within one year or the operating cycle, if longer.
OtherReceivablesNetCurrent.label: Other Receivables, Net, Current

OtherRestructuringCosts.description: Amount of other expenses associated with exit or disposal activities pursuant to an authorized plan. Excludes expenses associated with a discontinued operation or an asset retirement obligation.
OtherRestructuringCosts.label: Other Restructuring Costs

OtherSignificantNoncashTransactionValueO.description: "The value of the noncash (or part noncash) consideration given (for example, liability, equity) in a transaction. Noncash is defined as transactions during a period that do not result in cash receipts or cash payments in the period. ""Part noncash"" refers to that portion of a transaction not resulting in cash receipts or cash payments in the period."
OtherSignificantNoncashTransactionValueO.label: Other Significant Noncash Transaction, Value of Consideration Given

OtherSundryLiabilitiesCurrent.description: Obligations not otherwise itemized or categorized in the footnotes to the financial statements that are due within one year or operating cycle, if longer, from the balance sheet date.
OtherSundryLiabilitiesCurrent.label: Other Sundry Liabilities, Current

OtherSundryLiabilitiesNoncurrent.description: Obligations not otherwise itemized or categorized in the footnotes to the financial statements that are expected to be paid after one year (or the normal operating cycle, if longer), from the balance sheet date.
OtherSundryLiabilitiesNoncurrent.label: Other Sundry Liabilities, Noncurrent

OtherTaxExpenseBenefit.description: Amount of other income tax expense (benefit).
OtherTaxExpenseBenefit.label: Other Tax Expense (Benefit)

PaymentsForCapitalImprovements.description: The cash outflow for acquisition of or capital improvements to properties held for investment (operating, managed, leased) or for use.
PaymentsForCapitalImprovements.label: Payments for Capital Improvements

PaymentsForDerivativeInstrumentFinancing.description: The cash outflow for derivative instruments during the period, which are classified as financing activities, excluding those designated as hedging instruments.
PaymentsForDerivativeInstrumentFinancing.label: Payments for Derivative Instrument, Financing Activities

PaymentsForProceedsFromDerivativeInstrum.description: The net cash outflow or inflow from derivative instruments during the period, which are classified as financing activities, excluding those designated as hedging instruments.
PaymentsForProceedsFromDerivativeInstrum.label: Payments for (Proceeds from) Derivative Instrument, Financing Activities

PaymentsForProceedsFromOtherInvestingAct.description: Amount of cash (inflow) outflow from investing activities classified as other.
PaymentsForProceedsFromOtherInvestingAct.label: Payments for (Proceeds from) Other Investing Activities

PaymentsForProceedsFromPreviousAcquisiti.description: The net cash inflow or outflow associated with the aggregate amount of adjustment to the purchase price of a previous acquisition.
PaymentsForProceedsFromPreviousAcquisiti.label: Payments for (Proceeds from) Previous Acquisition

PaymentsForRepurchaseOfCommonStock.description: The cash outflow to reacquire common stock during the period.
PaymentsForRepurchaseOfCommonStock.label: Payments for Repurchase of Common Stock

PaymentsForRepurchaseOfEquity.description: The cash outflow to reacquire common and preferred stock.
PaymentsForRepurchaseOfEquity.label: Payments for Repurchase of Equity

PaymentsForRepurchaseOfRedeemableNoncont.description: The cash outflow during the period for redemption of redeemable noncontrolling interests.
PaymentsForRepurchaseOfRedeemableNoncont.label: Payments for Repurchase of Redeemable Noncontrolling Interest

PaymentsForRestructuring.description: Amount of cash payments made as the result of exit or disposal activities. Excludes payments associated with a discontinued operation or an asset retirement obligation.
PaymentsForRestructuring.label: Payments for Restructuring

PaymentsOfDebtIssuanceCosts.description: The cash outflow paid to third parties in connection with debt origination, which will be amortized over the remaining maturity period of the associated long-term debt.
PaymentsOfDebtIssuanceCosts.label: Payments of Debt Issuance Costs

PaymentsOfDividends.description: Cash outflow in the form of capital distributions and dividends to common shareholders, preferred shareholders and noncontrolling interests.
PaymentsOfDividends.label: Payments of Dividends

PaymentsOfDividendsCommonStock.description: Amount of cash outflow in the form of ordinary dividends to common shareholders of the parent entity.
PaymentsOfDividendsCommonStock.label: Payments of Ordinary Dividends, Common Stock

PaymentsOfFinancingCosts.description: The cash outflow for loan and debt issuance costs.
PaymentsOfFinancingCosts.label: Payments of Financing Costs

PaymentsRelatedToTaxWithholdingForShareB.description: Amount of cash outflow to satisfy grantee's tax withholding obligation for award under share-based payment arrangement.
PaymentsRelatedToTaxWithholdingForShareB.label: Payment, Tax Withholding, Share-based Payment Arrangement

PaymentsToAcquireBusinessesGross.description: The cash outflow associated with the acquisition of business during the period. The cash portion only of the acquisition price.
PaymentsToAcquireBusinessesGross.label: Payments to Acquire Businesses, Gross

PaymentsToAcquireBusinessesNetOfCashAcqu.description: The cash outflow associated with the acquisition of a business, net of the cash acquired from the purchase.
PaymentsToAcquireBusinessesNetOfCashAcqu.label: Payments to Acquire Businesses, Net of Cash Acquired

PaymentsToAcquireEquityMethodInvestments.description: The cash outflow associated with the purchase of or advances to an equity method investments, which are investments in joint ventures and entities in which the entity has an equity ownership interest normally of 20 to 50 percent and exercises significant influence.
PaymentsToAcquireEquityMethodInvestments.label: Payments to Acquire Equity Method Investments

PaymentsToAcquireIntangibleAssets.description: The cash outflow to acquire asset without physical form usually arising from contractual or other legal rights, excluding goodwill.
PaymentsToAcquireIntangibleAssets.label: Payments to Acquire Intangible Assets

PaymentsToAcquireInvestments.description: The cash outflow associated with the purchase of all investments (debt, security, other) during the period.
PaymentsToAcquireInvestments.label: Payments to Acquire Investments

PaymentsToAcquireNotesReceivable.description: The cash outflow to acquire an agreement for an unconditional promise by the maker to pay the entity (holder) a definite sum of money at a future date. Such amount may include accrued interest receivable in accordance with the terms of the note. The note also may contain provisions including a discount or premium, payable on demand, secured, or unsecured, interest bearing or noninterest bearing, among myriad other features and characteristics.
PaymentsToAcquireNotesReceivable.label: Payments to Acquire Notes Receivable

PaymentsToAcquireOtherInvestments.description: Amount of cash outflow to acquire investments classified as other.
PaymentsToAcquireOtherInvestments.label: Payments to Acquire Other Investments

PaymentsToAcquireProductiveAssets.description: The cash outflow for purchases of and capital improvements on property, plant and equipment (capital expenditures), software, and other intangible assets.
PaymentsToAcquireProductiveAssets.label: Payments to Acquire Productive Assets

PaymentsToAcquirePropertyPlantAndEquipme.description: The cash outflow associated with the acquisition of long-lived, physical assets that are used in the normal conduct of business to produce goods and services and not intended for resale; includes cash outflows to pay for construction of self-constructed assets.
PaymentsToAcquirePropertyPlantAndEquipme.label: Payments to Acquire Property, Plant, and Equipment

PensionAndOtherPostretirementDefinedBene.description: Amount of liability, recognized in statement of financial position, for defined benefit pension and other postretirement plans, classified as noncurrent.
PensionAndOtherPostretirementDefinedBene.label: Liability, Defined Benefit Plan, Noncurrent

PensionContributions.description: Amount of cash outflow for pension benefit. Includes, but is not limited to, employer contribution to fund plan asset and payment to retiree. Excludes other postretirement benefit.
PensionContributions.label: Payment for Pension Benefits

PreferredStockParOrStatedValuePerShare.description: Face amount or stated value per share of preferred stock nonredeemable or redeemable solely at the option of the issuer.
PreferredStockParOrStatedValuePerShare.label: Preferred Stock, Par or Stated Value Per Share

PreferredStockSharesAuthorized.description: The maximum number of nonredeemable preferred shares (or preferred stock redeemable solely at the option of the issuer) permitted to be issued by an entity's charter and bylaws.
PreferredStockSharesAuthorized.label: Preferred Stock, Shares Authorized

PreferredStockSharesIssued.description: Total number of nonredeemable preferred shares (or preferred stock redeemable solely at the option of the issuer) issued to shareholders (includes related preferred shares that were issued, repurchased, and remain in the treasury). May be all or portion of the number of preferred shares authorized. Excludes preferred shares that are classified as debt.
PreferredStockSharesIssued.label: Preferred Stock, Shares Issued

PreferredStockValue.description: Aggregate par or stated value of issued nonredeemable preferred stock (or preferred stock redeemable solely at the option of the issuer). This item includes treasury stock repurchased by the entity. Note: elements for number of nonredeemable preferred shares, par value and other disclosure concepts are in another section within stockholders' equity.
PreferredStockValue.label: Preferred Stock, Value, Issued

PrepaidAdvertising.description: Amount of consideration paid in advance for advertising that provides economic benefits within a future period of one year or the normal operating cycle, if longer.
PrepaidAdvertising.label: Prepaid Advertising

PrepaidExpenseAndOtherAssetsCurrent.description: Amount of asset related to consideration paid in advance for costs that provide economic benefits in future periods, and amount of other assets that are expected to be realized or consumed within one year or the normal operating cycle, if longer.
PrepaidExpenseAndOtherAssetsCurrent.label: Prepaid Expense and Other Assets, Current

PrepaidExpenseCurrent.description: Amount of asset related to consideration paid in advance for costs that provide economic benefits within a future period of one year or the normal operating cycle, if longer.
PrepaidExpenseCurrent.label: Prepaid Expense, Current

PrepaidTaxes.description: Amount of asset related to consideration paid in advance for income and other taxes that provide economic benefits within a future period of one year or the normal operating cycle, if longer.
PrepaidTaxes.label: Prepaid Taxes

ProceedsFromContributionsFromAffiliates.description: The cash inflow from an entity that is affiliated with the entity by means of direct or indirect ownership.
ProceedsFromContributionsFromAffiliates.label: Proceeds from Contributions from Affiliates

ProceedsFromEquityMethodInvestmentDivide.description: Amount of distribution received from equity method investee for return of investment, classified as investing activities. Excludes distribution for return on investment, classified as operating activities.
ProceedsFromEquityMethodInvestmentDivide.label: Proceeds from Equity Method Investment, Distribution, Return of Capital

ProceedsFromHedgeFinancingActivities.description: The cash inflow from a financial contract that meets the hedge criteria as either cash flow hedge, fair value hedge or hedge of net investment in foreign operations.
ProceedsFromHedgeFinancingActivities.label: Proceeds from Hedge, Financing Activities

ProceedsFromIssuanceOfCommercialPaper.description: The cash inflow from borrowing by issuing commercial paper.
ProceedsFromIssuanceOfCommercialPaper.label: Proceeds from Issuance of Commercial Paper

ProceedsFromIssuanceOfCommonStock.description: The cash inflow from the additional capital contribution to the entity.
ProceedsFromIssuanceOfCommonStock.label: Proceeds from Issuance of Common Stock

ProceedsFromIssuanceOfMediumTermNotes.description: The cash inflow from a debt funding received on a regular basis with maturities ranging from 5-10 years.
ProceedsFromIssuanceOfMediumTermNotes.label: Proceeds from Issuance of Medium-term Notes

ProceedsFromIssuanceOfSeniorLongTermDebt.description: The cash inflow from a borrowing with the highest claim on the assets of the entity in case of bankruptcy or liquidation (with maturities initially due after one year or beyond the operating cycle, if longer).
ProceedsFromIssuanceOfSeniorLongTermDebt.label: Proceeds from Issuance of Senior Long-term Debt

ProceedsFromIssuanceOfUnsecuredDebt.description: The cash inflow from the issuance of long-term debt that is not secured by collateral. Excludes proceeds from tax exempt unsecured debt.
ProceedsFromIssuanceOfUnsecuredDebt.label: Proceeds from Issuance of Unsecured Debt

ProceedsFromLicenseFeesReceived.description: Cash received from licensees for license fees during the current period.
ProceedsFromLicenseFeesReceived.label: Proceeds from License Fees Received

ProceedsFromLongTermLinesOfCredit.description: The cash inflow from a contractual arrangement with the lender, including letter of credit, standby letter of credit and revolving credit arrangements, under which borrowings can be made up to a specific amount at any point in time with maturities due beyond one year or the operating cycle, if longer.
ProceedsFromLongTermLinesOfCredit.label: Proceeds from Long-term Lines of Credit

ProceedsFromNotesPayable.description: The cash inflow from a borrowing supported by a written promise to pay an obligation.
ProceedsFromNotesPayable.label: Proceeds from Notes Payable

ProceedsFromPaymentsForOtherFinancingAct.description: Amount of cash inflow (outflow) from financing activities classified as other.
ProceedsFromPaymentsForOtherFinancingAct.label: Proceeds from (Payments for) Other Financing Activities

ProceedsFromPaymentsToMinorityShareholde.description: Amount of cash inflow (outflow) from (to) a noncontrolling interest. Excludes dividends paid to the noncontrolling interest.
ProceedsFromPaymentsToMinorityShareholde.label: Proceeds from (Payments to) Noncontrolling Interests

ProceedsFromRelatedPartyDebt.description: The cash inflow from a long-term borrowing made from related parties where one party can exercise control or significant influence over another party; including affiliates, owners or officers and their immediate families, pension trusts, and so forth. Alternate caption: Proceeds from Advances from Affiliates.
ProceedsFromRelatedPartyDebt.label: Proceeds from Related Party Debt

ProceedsFromRepaymentsOfCommercialPaper.description: The net cash inflow or cash outflow from issuing (borrowing) and repaying commercial paper.
ProceedsFromRepaymentsOfCommercialPaper.label: Proceeds from (Repayments of) Commercial Paper

ProceedsFromRepaymentsOfLinesOfCredit.description: The net cash inflow or cash outflow from a contractual arrangement with the lender, including letter of credit, standby letter of credit and revolving credit arrangements, under which borrowings can be made up to a specific amount at any point in time with either short term or long term maturity that is collateralized (backed by pledge, mortgage or other lien in the entity's assets).
ProceedsFromRepaymentsOfLinesOfCredit.label: Proceeds from (Repayments of) Lines of Credit

ProceedsFromRepaymentsOfRelatedPartyDebt.description: Amount of cash inflow (outflow) from long-term debt by a related party. Related parties, include, but are not limited to, affiliates, owners or officers and their immediate families, and pension trusts.
ProceedsFromRepaymentsOfRelatedPartyDebt.label: Proceeds from (Repayments of) Related Party Debt

ProceedsFromSaleOfEquityMethodInvestment.description: The cash inflow associated with the sale of equity method investments, which are investments in joint ventures and entities in which the entity has an equity ownership interest normally of 20 to 50 percent and exercises significant influence.
ProceedsFromSaleOfEquityMethodInvestment.label: Proceeds from Sale of Equity Method Investments

ProceedsFromSaleOfIntangibleAssets.description: The cash inflow from disposal of asset without physical form usually arising from contractual or other legal rights, excluding goodwill.
ProceedsFromSaleOfIntangibleAssets.label: Proceeds from Sale of Intangible Assets

ProceedsFromSaleOfPropertyPlantAndEquipm.description: The cash inflow from the sale of long-lived, physical assets that are used in the normal conduct of business to produce goods and services and not intended for resale.
ProceedsFromSaleOfPropertyPlantAndEquipm.label: Proceeds from Sale of Property, Plant, and Equipment

ProceedsFromShortTermDebt.description: The cash inflow from a borrowing having initial term of repayment within one year or the normal operating cycle, if longer.
ProceedsFromShortTermDebt.label: Proceeds from Short-term Debt

ProceedsFromStockOptionsExercised.description: Amount of cash inflow from exercise of option under share-based payment arrangement.
ProceedsFromStockOptionsExercised.label: Proceeds from Stock Options Exercised

ProductWarrantyAccrual.description: Carrying value as of the balance sheet date of obligations incurred through that date and payable for estimated claims under standard and extended warranty protection rights granted to customers.
ProductWarrantyAccrual.label: Standard and Extended Product Warranty Accrual

ProductWarrantyAccrualPreexistingIncreas.description: Amount of increase (decrease) in the standard and extended product warranty accrual from changes in estimates attributable to preexisting product warranties.
ProductWarrantyAccrualPreexistingIncreas.label: Standard and Extended Product Warranty Accrual, Increase (Decrease) for Preexisting Warranties

ProfitLoss.description: The consolidated profit or loss for the period, net of income taxes, including the portion attributable to the noncontrolling interest.
ProfitLoss.label: Net Income (Loss), Including Portion Attributable to Noncontrolling Interest

PropertyPlantAndEquipmentGross.description: Amount before accumulated depreciation, depletion and amortization of physical assets used in the normal conduct of business and not intended for resale. Examples include, but are not limited to, land, buildings, machinery and equipment, office equipment, and furniture and fixtures.
PropertyPlantAndEquipmentGross.label: Property, Plant and Equipment, Gross

PropertyPlantAndEquipmentNet.description: Amount after accumulated depreciation, depletion and amortization of physical assets used in the normal conduct of business to produce goods and services and not intended for resale. Examples include, but are not limited to, land, buildings, machinery and equipment, office equipment, and furniture and fixtures.
PropertyPlantAndEquipmentNet.label: Property, Plant and Equipment, Net

ProvisionForDoubtfulAccounts.description: Amount of expense (reversal of expense) for expected credit loss on accounts receivable.
ProvisionForDoubtfulAccounts.label: Accounts Receivable, Credit Loss Expense (Reversal)

ProvisionForLoanLeaseAndOtherLosses.description: Amount of expense related loan transactions, lease transactions, credit loss from transactions other than loan and lease transactions, and other loss based on assessment of uncollectability from the counterparty to reduce the account to their net realizable value.
ProvisionForLoanLeaseAndOtherLosses.label: Provision for Loan, Lease, and Other Losses

ProvisionForOtherLosses.description: Amount of expense related to other loss.
ProvisionForOtherLosses.label: Provision for Other Losses

ReclassificationFromAccumulatedOtherComp.description: Amount after tax of reclassification adjustments of other comprehensive income (loss).
ReclassificationFromAccumulatedOtherComp.label: Reclassification from Accumulated Other Comprehensive Income, Current Period, Net of Tax

ReclassificationFromAociCurrentPeriodTax.description: Amount of tax expense (benefit) of reclassification adjustment from accumulated other comprehensive income (loss).
ReclassificationFromAociCurrentPeriodTax.label: Reclassification from AOCI, Current Period, Tax

ReclassificationsOfTemporaryToPermanentE.description: The difference between the carrying amount of a financial instrument subject to a registration payment arrangement recorded as temporary equity prior to adoption of FSP EITF 00-19-2 and the carrying amount reclassified to permanent equity upon the adoption of FSP EITF 00-19-2. Recorded as a cumulative effect adjustment to the beginning balance of retained earnings. Does not apply to registration payment arrangements that are no longer outstanding upon adoption of FSP EITF 00-19-2.
ReclassificationsOfTemporaryToPermanentE.label: Reclassifications of Temporary to Permanent Equity

RecognitionOfDeferredRevenue.description: The amount of previously reported deferred or unearned revenue that was recognized as revenue during the period. For cash flows, this element primarily pertains to amortization of deferred credits on long-term arrangements. As a noncash item, it is deducted from net income when calculating cash provided by or used in operations using the indirect method.
RecognitionOfDeferredRevenue.label: Recognition of Deferred Revenue

RedeemableNoncontrollingInterestEquityCa.description: As of the reporting date, the aggregate carrying amount of all noncontrolling interests which are redeemable by the (parent) entity (1) at a fixed or determinable price on a fixed or determinable date, (2) at the option of the holder of the noncontrolling interest, or (3) upon occurrence of an event that is not solely within the control of the (parent) entity. This item includes noncontrolling interest holder's ownership (or holders' ownership) regardless of the type of equity interest (common, preferred, other) including all potential organizational (legal) forms of the investee entity.
RedeemableNoncontrollingInterestEquityCa.label: Redeemable Noncontrolling Interest, Equity, Carrying Amount

RedeemableNoncontrollingInterestEquityCo.description: As of the reporting date, the carrying amount of noncontrolling interests which are redeemable by the (parent) entity (1) at a fixed or determinable price on a fixed or determinable date, (2) at the option of the holder of the noncontrolling interest, or (3) upon occurrence of an event that is not solely within the control of the (parent) entity. The noncontrolling interest holder's ownership (or holders' ownership) may be in the form of common shares (regardless of class), limited partnership units (regardless of class), non-preferential membership interests, or any other form of common equity regardless of investee entity legal form.
RedeemableNoncontrollingInterestEquityCo.label: Redeemable Noncontrolling Interest, Equity, Common, Carrying Amount

RelatedPartyTransactionExpensesFromTrans.description: Expenses recognized resulting from transactions (excluding transactions that are eliminated in consolidated or combined financial statements) with related party.
RelatedPartyTransactionExpensesFromTrans.label: Related Party Transaction, Expenses from Transactions with Related Party

RelatedPartyTransactionOtherRevenuesFrom.description: Reflects the sum of all other revenue and income realized from sales and other transactions (excluding transactions that are eliminated in consolidated or combined financial statements) with related party during the period.
RelatedPartyTransactionOtherRevenuesFrom.label: Related Party Transaction, Other Revenues from Transactions with Related Party

RelatedPartyTransactionPurchasesFromRela.description: Purchases during the period (excluding transactions that are eliminated in consolidated or combined financial statements) with related party.
RelatedPartyTransactionPurchasesFromRela.label: Related Party Transaction, Purchases from Related Party

RelatedPartyTransactionRevenuesFromTrans.description: Revenues, net of returns and allowances, realized from sales and other transactions (excluding transactions that are eliminated in consolidated or combined financial statements) with related party during the period.
RelatedPartyTransactionRevenuesFromTrans.label: Related Party Transaction, Revenues from Transactions with Related Party (Deprecated 2012-01-31)

RepaymentOfNotesReceivableFromRelatedPar.description: The cash inflow from a loan, supported by a promissory note, granted to related parties where one party can exercise control or significant influence over another party; including affiliates, owners or officers and their immediate families, pension trusts, and so forth.
RepaymentOfNotesReceivableFromRelatedPar.label: Repayment of Notes Receivable from Related Parties

RepaymentsOfCommercialPaper.description: The cash outflow due to repaying amounts borrowed by issuing commercial paper.
RepaymentsOfCommercialPaper.label: Repayments of Commercial Paper

RepaymentsOfLongTermCapitalLeaseObligati.description: The cash outflow for the obligation for a lease meeting the criteria for capitalization (with maturities exceeding one year or beyond the operating cycle of the entity, if longer).
RepaymentsOfLongTermCapitalLeaseObligati.label: Repayments of Long-term Capital Lease Obligations

RepaymentsOfLongTermDebt.description: The cash outflow for debt initially having maturity due after one year or beyond the normal operating cycle, if longer.
RepaymentsOfLongTermDebt.label: Repayments of Long-term Debt

RepaymentsOfLongTermLinesOfCredit.description: The cash outflow for the settlement of obligation drawn from a contractual arrangement with the lender, including letter of credit, standby letter of credit and revolving credit arrangements, under which borrowings can be made up to a specific amount at any point in time with maturities due beyond one year or the operating cycle, if longer.
RepaymentsOfLongTermLinesOfCredit.label: Repayments of Long-term Lines of Credit

RepaymentsOfMediumTermNotes.description: The cash outflow to pay off borrowing used to receive debt funding on a regular basis with maturities ranging from 5-10 years.
RepaymentsOfMediumTermNotes.label: Repayments of Medium-term Notes

RepaymentsOfNotesPayable.description: The cash outflow for a borrowing supported by a written promise to pay an obligation.
RepaymentsOfNotesPayable.label: Repayments of Notes Payable

RepaymentsOfRelatedPartyDebt.description: The cash outflow for the payment of a long-term borrowing made from a related party where one party can exercise control or significant influence over another party; including affiliates, owners or officers and their immediate families, pension trusts, and so forth. Alternate caption: Payments for Advances from Affiliates.
RepaymentsOfRelatedPartyDebt.label: Repayments of Related Party Debt

RepaymentsOfSeniorDebt.description: The cash outflow for a long-term debt where the holder has highest claim on the entity's asset in case of bankruptcy or liquidation during the period.
RepaymentsOfSeniorDebt.label: Repayments of Senior Debt

RepaymentsOfUnsecuredDebt.description: The cash outflow to repay long-term debt that is not secured by collateral. Excludes repayments of tax exempt unsecured debt.
RepaymentsOfUnsecuredDebt.label: Repayments of Unsecured Debt

ReportingUnitPercentageOfFairValueInExce.description: Percentage of fair value of reporting unit in excess of carrying amount.
ReportingUnitPercentageOfFairValueInExce.label: Reporting Unit, Percentage of Fair Value in Excess of Carrying Amount

ResearchAndDevelopmentExpense.description: The aggregate costs incurred (1) in a planned search or critical investigation aimed at discovery of new knowledge with the hope that such knowledge will be useful in developing a new product or service, a new process or technique, or in bringing about a significant improvement to an existing product or process; or (2) to translate research findings or other knowledge into a plan or design for a new product or process or for a significant improvement to an existing product or process whether intended for sale or the entity's use, during the reporting period charged to research and development projects, including the costs of developing computer software up to the point in time of achieving technological feasibility, and costs allocated in accounting for a business combination to in-process projects deemed to have no alternative future use.
ResearchAndDevelopmentExpense.label: Research and Development Expense

RestrictedCashAndCashEquivalents.description: Amount of cash and cash equivalents restricted as to withdrawal or usage. Cash includes, but is not limited to, currency on hand, demand deposits with banks or financial institutions, and other accounts with general characteristics of demand deposits. Cash equivalents include, but are not limited to, short-term, highly liquid investments that are both readily convertible to known amounts of cash and so near their maturity that they present insignificant risk of changes in value because of changes in interest rates.
RestrictedCashAndCashEquivalents.label: Restricted Cash and Cash Equivalents

RestrictedCashAndCashEquivalentsAtCarryi.description: Amount of cash and cash equivalents restricted as to withdrawal or usage, classified as current. Cash includes, but is not limited to, currency on hand, demand deposits with banks or financial institutions, and other accounts with general characteristics of demand deposits. Cash equivalents include, but are not limited to, short-term, highly liquid investments that are both readily convertible to known amounts of cash and so near their maturity that they present insignificant risk of changes in value because of changes in interest rates.
RestrictedCashAndCashEquivalentsAtCarryi.label: Restricted Cash and Cash Equivalents, Current

RestrictedCashAndCashEquivalentsNoncurre.description: Amount of cash and cash equivalents restricted as to withdrawal or usage, classified as noncurrent. Cash includes, but is not limited to, currency on hand, demand deposits with banks or financial institutions, and other accounts with general characteristics of demand deposits. Cash equivalents include, but are not limited to, short-term, highly liquid investments that are both readily convertible to known amounts of cash and so near their maturity that they present insignificant risk of changes in value because of changes in interest rates.
RestrictedCashAndCashEquivalentsNoncurre.label: Restricted Cash and Cash Equivalents, Noncurrent

RestrictedCashAndInvestmentsNoncurrent.description: The noncurrent cash, cash equivalents and investments that is restricted as to withdrawal or usage. Restrictions may include legally restricted deposits held as compensating balances against borrowing arrangements, contracts entered into with others, or entity statements of intention with regard to particular deposits classified as long-term; that is not expected to be released from such existing restrictions within one year of the balance sheet date or operating cycle, whichever is longer. Excludes compensating balance arrangements that are not agreements which legally restrict the use of cash amounts shown on the balance sheet. Includes noncurrent cash equivalents and investments that are similarly restricted as to withdrawal, usage or disposal.
RestrictedCashAndInvestmentsNoncurrent.label: Restricted Cash and Investments, Noncurrent

RestrictedInvestmentsAtFairValue.description: The aggregate value of all restricted investments.
RestrictedInvestmentsAtFairValue.label: Restricted Investments, at Fair Value

RestructuringAndRelatedCostExpectedCost1.description: Amount expected to be recognized in earnings for the specified restructuring cost.
RestructuringAndRelatedCostExpectedCost1.label: Restructuring and Related Cost, Expected Cost

RestructuringAndRelatedCostIncurredCost.description: Discloses the amount charged against the accrued restructuring reserves, or earnings if not previously accrued, during the period for the specified type of restructuring cost.
RestructuringAndRelatedCostIncurredCost.label: Restructuring and Related Cost, Incurred Cost

RestructuringCharges.description: Amount of expenses associated with exit or disposal activities pursuant to an authorized plan. Excludes expenses related to a discontinued operation or an asset retirement obligation.
RestructuringCharges.label: Restructuring Charges

RestructuringCosts.description: Amount, after cash payment, of expenses associated with exit or disposal activities pursuant to an authorized plan. Excludes expenses related to a discontinued operation or an asset retirement obligation.
RestructuringCosts.label: Restructuring Costs

RestructuringReserve.description: Carrying amount (including both current and noncurrent portions of the accrual) as of the balance sheet date pertaining to a specified type of cost associated with exit from or disposal of business activities or restructuring pursuant to a duly authorized plan.
RestructuringReserve.label: Restructuring Reserve

RestructuringReserveAccrualAdjustment1.description: Amount of expense (reversal of expense) which increases (decreases) the restructuring reserve from an adjustment to a previously accrued restructuring liability.
RestructuringReserveAccrualAdjustment1.label: Restructuring Reserve, Accrual Adjustment

RestructuringReserveSettledWithoutCash.description: Amount of consideration other than cash paid in the period to fully or partially settle a specified, previously accrued type of restructuring cost.
RestructuringReserveSettledWithoutCash.label: Restructuring Reserve, Settled Without Cash (Deprecated 2013-01-31)

RetainedEarningsAccumulatedDeficit.description: The cumulative amount of the reporting entity's undistributed earnings or deficit.
RetainedEarningsAccumulatedDeficit.label: Retained Earnings (Accumulated Deficit)

RevenueFromContractWithCustomerExcluding.description: Amount, excluding tax collected from customer, of revenue from satisfaction of performance obligation by transferring promised good or service to customer. Tax collected from customer is tax assessed by governmental authority that is both imposed on and concurrent with specific revenue-producing transaction, including, but not limited to, sales, use, value added and excise.
RevenueFromContractWithCustomerExcluding.label: Revenue from Contract with Customer, Excluding Assessed Tax

RevenueFromRelatedParties.description: Amount of revenue, fees and commissions earned from transactions between (a) a parent company and its subsidiaries; (b) subsidiaries of a common parent; (c) an entity and trusts for the benefit of employees, for example, but not limited to, pension and profit-sharing trusts that are managed by or under the trusteeship of the entity's management; (d) an entity and its principal, owners, management, or members of their immediate families; and (e) affiliates.
RevenueFromRelatedParties.label: Revenue from Related Parties

RightOfUseAssetObtainedInExchangeForFina.description: Amount of increase in right-of-use asset obtained in exchange for finance lease liability.
RightOfUseAssetObtainedInExchangeForFina.label: Right-of-Use Asset Obtained in Exchange for Finance Lease Liability

RightOfUseAssetObtainedInExchangeForOper.description: Amount of increase in right-of-use asset obtained in exchange for operating lease liability.
RightOfUseAssetObtainedInExchangeForOper.label: Right-of-Use Asset Obtained in Exchange for Operating Lease Liability

SaleAndLeasebackTransactionGainLossNet.description: Amount of gain (loss) on sale and leaseback transaction from transfer of asset accounted for as sale.
SaleAndLeasebackTransactionGainLossNet.label: Sale and Leaseback Transaction, Gain (Loss), Net

SaleLeasebackTransactionNetBookValue.description: The net book value of the asset(s) sold in connection with the sale of the property to another party and lease back to the seller.
SaleLeasebackTransactionNetBookValue.label: Sale Leaseback Transaction, Net Book Value

SalesDiscountsReturnsAndAllowancesGoods.description: Aggregate of: (i) sales discounts given by the entity, including, but not limited to, early payments of accounts due, (ii) the total deduction from sales during the period arising from goods returned by customers (other than under warranty provisions), and (iii) price reductions (allowance, price protection agreements) given by the entity. Discounts, returns and allowances are a deduction from gross revenue in arriving at net revenue.
SalesDiscountsReturnsAndAllowancesGoods.label: Sales Discounts, Returns and Allowances, Goods (Deprecated 2018-01-31)

SalesRevenueNet.description: Total revenue from sale of goods and services rendered during the reporting period, in the normal course of business, reduced by sales returns and allowances, and sales discounts.
SalesRevenueNet.label: Revenue, Net (Deprecated 2018-01-31)

SegmentReportingAssetReconcilingItemAmou.description: Amount of an item in the reconciliation of total assets from reportable segments to the entity's consolidated assets.
SegmentReportingAssetReconcilingItemAmou.label: Segment Reporting, Asset Reconciling Item, Amount (Deprecated 2011-01-31)

SegmentReportingInformationAmortizationE.description: Amount of amortization expense for the reportable segment.
SegmentReportingInformationAmortizationE.label: Segment Reporting Information, Amortization Expense (Deprecated 2011-01-31)

SegmentReportingInformationDepreciationE.description: Amount of depreciation expense for the reportable segment. Such disclosure is presented if the amount is: (a) included in the measure of segment profit or loss reviewed by the chief operating decision maker or (b) otherwise regularly provided to the chief operating decision maker, even if not included in that measure of segment profit or loss.
SegmentReportingInformationDepreciationE.label: Segment Reporting Information, Depreciation Expense (Deprecated 2011-01-31)

SegmentReportingInformationOtherAssets.description: Carrying amount of assets attributed to the reportable segment that are not otherwise specified in the taxonomy.
SegmentReportingInformationOtherAssets.label: Segment Reporting Information, Other Assets (Deprecated 2011-01-31)

SegmentReportingInformationPropertyPlant.description: Tangible assets attributed to the reportable segment for use in the production or supply of goods and services, for rental to others, or for administrative purposes, net of accumulated depreciation. Examples include land, buildings, machinery, vehicles, furniture, and computer equipment.
SegmentReportingInformationPropertyPlant.label: Segment Reporting Information, Property, Plant, and Equipment, Net (Deprecated 2011-01-31)

SegmentReportingReconcilingItemsAssets.description: Total of reconciling items between total reportable segments' assets and consolidated entity assets.
SegmentReportingReconcilingItemsAssets.label: Segment Reporting, Reconciling Items, Assets (Deprecated 2011-01-31)

SegmentReportingSegmentOperatingProfitLo.description: The total amount of profit or loss for reportable segments.
SegmentReportingSegmentOperatingProfitLo.label: Segment Reporting, Segment Operating Profit (Loss) (Deprecated 2011-01-31)
